jobs.title: Product Manager Platform (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Product Manager Platform (m/w/d) gestaltest du das Herzstück unserer IoT- und Cloud-Plattform KiwiOS. Du verbindest strategische Marktanforderungen mit technischer Exzellenz, steuerst das Plattform-Ökosystem über den gesamten Lebenszyklus und treibst die internationale Skalierung unseres Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)-Modells für den dezentralen Energiemarkt aktiv voran.

  • strategische Vision & Roadmap: Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung der Produktvision, Roadmap und Value Proposition für unsere Plattform und zugehörige Services (z. B. KiwiOS.cloud, Energy Manager).
  • Business Cases & Pricing: Erarbeitung von Business Cases, Preismodellen und Pricing-Strategien im PaaS-Kontext inklusive Stakeholder-Abstimmung.
  • Partner-Akquise & Ökosystem: Identifizierung, Bewertung und Gewinnung strategischer Plattformpartner zur Erweiterung unseres Ökosystems.

  • Requirements & Spezifikationen: Übersetzung strategischer Business Use Cases und Kundenanforderungen in funktionale/technische Spezifikationen und Epics.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern: Enge Abstimmung bei Feature-Spezifikationen und Unterstützung bei der klaren Backlog-Priorisierung.
  • Produkt-Dokumentation & Schnittstellen: Zusammenarbeit mit der Technischen Redaktion zur optimalen Dokumentation der Plattform und APIs.

Dein Profil

  • erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • gutes Verständnis von Cloud-Architekturen, Edge-Technologien und API-First-Konzepten. Fundierte Kenntnisse im Pricing, der Monetarisierung und der Betriebswirtschaft von SaaS/PaaS-Geschäftsmodellen.

  • starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, ausgeprägte Klärungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz an der Schnittstelle zwischen Tech und Business, strukturierte Projektabwicklung sowie Hands-On-Mentalität.

jobs.title: Product Owner PLM (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As Product Owner for our internal Product Lifecycle Management platform Sloth, you will drive the evolution of one of Quantum Systems' most critical digital products.   • Translate business needs / processes into clear requirements and priorities

  • Partner with stakeholders across R&D, Production, Supply Chain and Product Management

  • Facilitate decision-making and manage competing priorities

  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement of PLM processes

  • Guide the internal development team and steer delivery outcomes

  • Establish governance, transparency and long-term platform strategy



What you bring to the team:

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Process Owner or similar role

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into product initiatives

  • Experience managing roadmaps, backlogs and prioritization processes

  • Structured and pragmatic approach to problem solving

  • Fluent English

Nice to Have

  • Experience with PLM, PDM, ERP or manufacturing systems

  • Background in product development, engineering or supply chain processes

  • Experience working in fast-growing technology organizations


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
  • Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets.
  • Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences.
  • A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders.


Your Profile

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products.
  • Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and turning complexity into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Based within a European time zone.


What’s in It for You

  • Join a profitable, growing software company with a strong global presence across Europe, North America, and APAC.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly scaling cloud platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide.
  • Work on high-impact platform experiences that influence how tens of thousands of users interact with Jedox every day.
  • Collaborate with talented international teams in a culture built around #OneTeam, innovation, and impactful results.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to products that deliver real customer value.
  • Help define strategic platform decisions that will shape the Jedox experience for years to come.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
  • Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
  • Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
  • Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
  • Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
  • Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.


Meet your team

You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

Introduction

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across 48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube. Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects, becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand.

Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany. The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward.


Your mission

  • Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects.

  • Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project.

  • Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures.

  • Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence.

  • Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations.

  • Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level

  • Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities.


Your profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field.

Why us?

The position requires flexibility for regular travel, including short-notice trips. You should be comfortable with traveling approximately at 10-15% of your work time.

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We're looking for people with software engineering backgrounds who are ready to move into technical project management, owning the business systems work behind our transition from a legacy stack to a new one. These are growth paths, not fully-formed PM seats.

Our legacy stack involves over 100 systems across the globe including proprietary invoicing/billing/scheduling systems, two Salesforce instances and NetSuite, among others. Our new stack is HubSpot, Metronome, Stripe, NetSuite, and Workato. Getting from one to the other — while the business keeps running on both — is the core challenge of both tracks.

We're hiring two people into this role. The skills profile is similar for both, but each hire will own one of two distinct tracks: O2C Integrations or CRM Projects. These tracks will eventually mature into a larger scope of internal tooling and enterprise customization. Track assignment will be based on candidate strengths and interest during onboarding, rather than decided in advance.

Track 1: Order-to-Cash Integrations Projects

Focused on building and connecting

  • Own the Order-to-Cash flow end-to-end — Across both tech stacks. You're accountable for how orders, invoicing, billing, and revenue data move through the business, regardless of which systems they touch.

  • Set integration ecosystem strategy — Define how integrations across business systems should be architected as a whole: point-to-point vs. centralized (e.g., via Workato), reusable patterns, and standards for how new systems connect in.

  • Co-build the Legacy system replacement s— Partner with the Enterprise product team as technical owner of how the new platform's O2C integration layer is architected, including data models and API contracts.

  • Control integration vendors — Own technical evaluation, SLAs, and build-vs-buy decisions for integration tooling and vendors across the ecosystem.

  • Bridge legacy and new-stack engineering teams — Be the technical point of contact ensuring O2C data contracts and dependencies are understood on both sides.

Track 2: CRM & Martech Projects

Focused on retiring and migrating CRM systems

  • Lead the Salesforce 2A sunset project — Own the plan, timeline, and execution for retiring this legacy Salesforce instance, coordinating data migration and cutover with dependent teams.

  • Lead the Salesforce STAR sunset project — Same ownership model, applied to the STAR instance.

  • Control the HubSpot vendor relationship — Own vendor management for HubSpot, including contract terms, SLA performance, and roadmap alignment with vendor capabilities.

  • Own marketing automations — Own the roadmap and execution for marketing automation workflows (built largely on HubSpot). Campaign strategy sits with Marketing; you own the tooling and execution layer those campaigns run on.

  • Manage sunset risk — Identify what breaks if a legacy system goes away too early, and build technically sound mitigation and rollback plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Software engineering background — you've built, maintained, or integrated production systems, ideally including APIs, middleware, or data pipelines.

  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders alike.

  • Detail oriented and structured approach — planning and running complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects to completion, including sequencing, risk management, and timeline ownership.

  • Comfortable reading and reasoning about system architecture and data models across multiple connected systems without translation from engineering.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, especially around evolving scope boundaries between adjacent teams during a platform migration.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with billing/invoicing/CRM systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot, Stripe, Metronome, Workato, or similar).

  • Experience with vendor management, including contract and SLA negotiation.

  • Background in a company undergoing a legacy-to-modern platform migration.

  • Experience defining integration strategy or standards at an organizational level, not just shipping individual integrations; exposure to integration architecture patterns (point-to-point, iPaaS/middleware, event-driven).

  • Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) — helpful but not required with structured ways of working

Why You Should Join

This is a rare, explicitly structured path out of pure engineering — you're hired as an engineer, judged on engineering judgment, and grow into project management on the job. You'll get unusually broad system exposure fast, which is the kind of company-wide operational map most engineers wait years to see. You will be joining a project management and product operations team and receive ongoing coaching for your career development.

#LI-PK1

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

jobs.title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

  • Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
  • Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
  • Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
  • Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
  • Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1.      Application with a few short questions

2.      Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5.      45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6.      Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

•     A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

•     Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

•     Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

•     Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

•     Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

•     €1,250 - €1,750 per month, depending on experience.

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

•     Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

•     You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

•     Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

•     International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

•     Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

•     Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.

•     Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

 

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

jobs.title: AI Content Engineer
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar. The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar. Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not. You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

  • You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad.
  • Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop.
  • 3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't.
  • Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses.
  • Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube.
  • Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure.
  • Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents.
  • You can shoot and cut video yourself.
  • Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.
  • Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • Colleagues in 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.
  • Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount.
  • Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to.
  • Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.
  • You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin.
  • Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure.

Hiring Process

  1. 15-minute phone screen - with a founder
  2. Short Assignment
  3. Craft deep dive (90 min)
  4. Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

jobs.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary Range: €55K - €68K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

We're looking for a Marketing Communications Manager (B2B) who spans brand and growth marketing - someone versatile enough to move across content and product marketing, but with a clear centre of gravity in storytelling and strategic content production. You'll be part of a hybrid team where everyone covers more than one surface, and you'll have real ownership across multiple workstreams from day one to do whatever brings the most impact to reach our company goals.

The core of the job is making Almedia’s expertise and brand impossible to ignore in the space of gaming, advertising, technology, data, consumer apps, scale-ups and growth companies, so we get noticed by partners. That means finding the signal inside a technically complex business, turning it into content that actually moves people and deals, and then making sure it reaches the right personas in the right way. The measure of success is simple: how many more people know about Almedia, and how many stakeholders reach out to us because of our initiatives and the collateral we publish, rather than the other way around.

You'll report to our Global B2B Marketing Lead, work closely with PR and event managers, and collaborate with the growth team and C-Suite to continuously develop the Almedia brand.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Drive flagship brand campaigns. Own brand campaigns end to end - from identifying the high-impact opportunity and building the story, through to channel rollout and measurement. You decide what gets done, made and why. The standard is that it needs to be worth actioning, not just worth reading.

  • Leverage the team. Find ways to use our 150+ people to source content and amplify the message, without adding to their workload, but making their contributions count.

  • Build and distribute the growth content engine. Develop white papers sourced from our own data, case studies with real customer evidence, a monthly newsletter, and campaign assets for our flagship events, then own how they get out into the world. Identify the right channels, the right timing, and the right formats to make sure what gets made actually gets read. Track whether it's working and adjust.

  • Make sales self-sufficient. Build a product marketing toolkit for Freecash and Link, including messaging, one-pagers, pitch decks, and case studies, so that active deals and existing partnerships use the collateral instead of improvised slides. Track adoption and close the loop with the sales team on what's actually working.

  • Grow Almedia's presence. Turn the work you produce into reputation. The white papers, case studies, and campaign assets you create should be doing double duty, showing up in pitches, feeding into event narratives, and giving Almedia a clear point of view in a crowded market. The goal is that people in our industry know who we are and what we stand for, because the content speaks for itself.

  • Bring stakeholders along. Get internal buy-in for marketing initiatives from people who have other priorities. Whether it's sourcing a customer story from sales, getting a C-Suite perspective into a white paper, or aligning leadership on a campaign direction, you know how to make marketing a team effort without making it someone else's problem.

  • Support event planning and execution. Organise the conferences, sponsorships, and brand activations Almedia shows up to — logistics, booth setup, timelines, vendor coordination.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Month 1: Learn the product suite, the sales motion, and the content gaps. Audit existing collateral and identify what's missing or not being used. Get onboarded on the brand activities and support planned activations and events with narrative and copy.

  • Month 2: Ship your first white paper or flagship content asset and own its distribution. Conceptualise a brand or growth-focused event.

  • Month 3: Own the growth side of the social and website content calendar. Have a working content calendar in place, and a feedback loop running between you, sales, and leadership on what's resonating. By this point you're running on your own.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strategic content thinking. You approach content as a lever, not a deliverable. You ask what outcome a piece needs to drive before you write a word, and you're just as focused on distribution and measurement as you are on the writing itself. You're not here to fill a content calendar, you're here to shift how our market thinks about Almedia.

  • C2-level B2B writing. You can take a complex product or technical concept and produce something a busy CMO would read in full. Long-form assets, white papers, case studies, product one-pagers, come out publish-ready, not draft-ready. You self-edit hard and don't need someone to rewrite your work.

  • Story sourcing instinct. You know how to find the interesting thing inside a business: the data point that reframes a conversation, the customer story that proves the value prop, the internal perspective that hasn't been said publicly yet. You don't wait for a brief to hand you a story.

  • Product marketing fundamentals. You've built or maintained messaging frameworks, value propositions, and sales collateral before. You understand how B2B buyers think and what makes a case study actually useful in a sales conversation versus something that sits in a Notion folder.

  • Project ownership. Complex projects, a website section, a flagship report, a product launch toolkit, run on your calendar, not someone else's. You track dependencies, manage vendors or freelancers when needed, and communicate proactively when something is off track.

  • Bonus: German or Turkish language skills for PR coordination.

  • Bonus: Background in adtech, mobile gaming, or performance marketing.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: A piece of content doesn't leave your hands until it's genuinely good, and neither does its distribution or results. You take accountability for the full outcome, not just your section of it.

  • Take Initiative: You spot the gap or content opportunity before someone points it out and you've already started filling it.

  • Move Fast: You run multiple workstreams in parallel, make decisions with incomplete information, and ship rather than polish indefinitely.

  • Focus on Impact: You know which content will move the needle and which is just noise, and you spend your time on the former. If something isn't working, you change course.

  • Raise the Bar: You push back when a brief is vague, when a case study is too generic, or when a deck doesn't actually say anything. High standards aren't a personality trait here, they're the job.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
jobs.description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Asset Impact
jobs.description:
Asset Impact is seeking an Account Manager whose primary responsibilities will be to own and develop existing accounts end-to-end. This spans client onboarding, relationship management, product delivery and business development. Reporting to senior management, the Account Manager will be directly responsible for our existing clients.

The position requires a candidate skilled in building and maintaining relationships across multiple stakeholders within large institutional clients. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in strategic account planning and execution and a customer-first mindset. They will have significant client-facing experience, be organized and highly detail-oriented, and enjoy structuring and improving internal processes.

We are also looking for a strong track record in account management and/or sales, particularly with, or within, financial institutions. Knowledge of sustainability and the energy transition is desirable but not essential.

In this role, you will play a vital part in the Asset Impact team. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with business development teams across the wider GRESB group to identify and realize cross-selling opportunities.

We offer a unique opportunity to play a global role in a mission-driven organization that is paving the way to a more sustainable economy.

Your responsibilities

We work with large global financial institutions, governments, consultancies, and non-profit organizations to catalyze action on climate change through data and analytics on the energy transition. In your role, you will own relationships with existing clients and partners, which include many of the world’s largest banks.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own account management framework and execution across the business.
  • Own long-term relationships across our book of existing institutional clients. Proactively understand and develop their priorities, use cases and challenges, and identify and develop key internal sponsors.
  • Meet net revenue retention targets by identifying and closing new business opportunities with existing clients.
  • Continuously monitor and improve account management strategy and execution, including through refinement of existing processes and tooling.
  • Convey feedback to the Product team to support the improvement of existing products and provide input to the product roadmap.
  • Manage delivery of products to clients, in coordination with the Product team.

Requirements

  • Five or more years of experience working in a client-facing role, for example in a consultant, sales or client relationship position. Previous experience in the areas of climate, sustainability and/or the financial industry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in building and managing relationships with institutional clients, particularly in the banking sector.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., business, engineering, economics, sustainable finance). Master’s degree is preferred.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to manage, improve and track account management processes and workflows.
  • Exemplary verbal and written communication skills. Fluency in English is mandatory.
  • Other European languages will be considered a strong plus, particularly French.
  • Based in London, Paris, or Amsterdam.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Annual professional development budget of €2,500 or equivalent, along with transport, meal allowance and additional benefits that vary by location.
  • A dynamic international team of sustainable finance specialists, data scientists and business experts passionate about the climate transition.
  • An impact-driven organization with wide-ranging opportunities to obtain hands-on experience, make your voice heard, and help shape the future of climate data in the financial industry.
  • Scope for your role and responsibilities to evolve over time along with the growth of GRESB/Asset Impact and in line with your skills and interests. Growth potential in team management, product expertise, and pre-sales capabilities.
  • The opportunity to develop your network by being involved with all types of sustainable finance stakeholders (banks, investment managers, technology and data companies, and industry bodies).
  • Offices in London, Paris, Berlin, and Amsterdam with opportunities for business-related travel.

If you meet our criteria and are passionate about driving sustainability and transparency in the financial industry, we would love to hear from you. Please submit a CV and cover letter in English detailing your relevant experience and motivation.

Asset Impact is proud to be an equal opportunity workspace. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital stavtus, veteran status, or disability status.

About Asset Impact

Asset Impact is a pioneering climate data and analytics firm on a mission to transform the financial system into a powerful force for net-zero. We empower financial institutions with the most comprehensive asset-based data solutions available.

Our unique approach maps physical assets across key sectors to companies and their investments, providing unparalleled transparency into climate risks and opportunities. Leading banks, asset managers, and regulators around the world rely on Asset Impact to measure their financed emissions, make informed investment decisions, and develop impactful net-zero transition strategies.

Asset Impact, formerly Asset Resolution, was established in 2018 in Paris by the 2 Degrees Investing Initiative, an innovative international think tank working to align financial markets with climate goals. In 2022, we became part of GRESB, the leading ESG benchmark for real estate and infrastructure investments, and became Asset Impact. We work globally and are expanding rapidly to support the growing needs of financial institutions as they embark on their journey to decarbonization.

Find out more at https://asset-impact.gresb.com/

ABOUT GRESB

GRESB is a mission-driven organisation and strategic partner for sustainable and high-performing investments across real assets and climate-critical industries. We help investment professionals mitigate risk and build portfolios that are resilient, efficient, and financially attractive for long-term success.

Our Vision: An investment industry that plays a central role in creating a sustainable world.

Our Mission: To provide financial markets with actionable sustainability insights, data, and benchmarks. More than 150 global institutional and financial investors with USD 53 trillion in assets under management rely on GRESB to help guide their investment decisions, mitigating risk, improving portfolio quality, and driving long-term financial success.

The GRESB team is an energetic group of more than 100 individuals from diverse backgrounds with experience spanning sustainability, data science, software development, real estate, infrastructure, and the capital markets. Most of us work out of our head office in Amsterdam or one of our satellite offices in London, Paris, Berlin, Boston, Singapore, or Sydney. We are passionate about tackling the sustainability challenge by providing the insights that will power the markets of the future and enable investors to allocate the world's capital in a more responsible way.

GRESB is a portfolio company of BeyondNetZero, General Atlantic's climate investing platform.

jobs.title: Head of Internal Control, Operational Risk - CDI (F/H)
jobs.description:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement européen agréé, qui accompagne les marketplaces et les plateformes de crowdfunding dans plus de 29 pays.

Nous fournissons des services de paiement sécurisés, conformes et évolutifs pour la nouvelle économie, notamment des services de KYC, de traitement des paiements, de détection de la fraude, de ségrégation des fonds et de gestion des comptes. Notre expertise technologique et réglementaire permet à nos clients de développer leur activité tout en respectant les standards les plus exigeants en matière de conformité et de sécurité.

Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs, Lemonway est une entreprise dynamique et internationale, au cœur de l’économie numérique. Nous combinons l’agilité d’une scale-up avec les exigences et les responsabilités d’un établissement financier réglementé.


Le poste

Rattaché(e) a notre Chief Compliance & Risk Officer, vous prenez en charge les activités de contrôle interne, de gestion des risques opérationnels et de gouvernance de Lemonway.

Vous veillez à ce que le profil de risque de l’entreprise soit correctement identifié, évalué, suivi et communiqué, tout en contribuant au renforcement de son environnement de contrôle et de sa culture du risque.

Vous managez une équipe de deux personnes et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le CEO, la Direction générale, les fonctions de contrôle et les équipes opérationnelles. En tant que véritable business partner, vous accompagnez l’entreprise dans ses prises de décision, tout en vous assurant que ses activités restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables, aux politiques internes et à l’appétit au risque défini.

Il s’agit d’un poste stratégique et opérationnel, particulièrement adapté à une personne qui apprécie de construire et d’améliorer des dispositifs dans un environnement international, en forte évolution et réglementé.

Les principales responsabilités :

Contrôle interne et contrôle permanent

  • Piloter et améliorer en continu le dispositif de contrôle interne de niveaux 1 et 2.

  • Définir, maintenir et mettre en œuvre le plan annuel de contrôle permanent.

  • Veiller à ce que les contrôles soient correctement conçus, documentés, réalisés et justifiés.

  • Développer les indicateurs de contrôle pertinents et les reportings destinés à la Direction et aux instances de gouvernance.

  • Identifier les faiblesses du dispositif de contrôle, évaluer leur impact et coordonner les actions correctives.

  • Promouvoir une culture forte du contrôle et de la gestion des risques dans l’ensemble de l’organisation.

  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’optimisation des outils et processus de type GRC.

Risques opérationnels et gestion des risques

  • Piloter le dispositif de gestion des risques opérationnels, notamment l’identification, l’évaluation et le suivi des risques.

  • Coordonner la préparation et la mise à jour régulière des cartographies des risques de l’entreprise.

  • Organiser et maintenir le Risk Appetite Framework, ainsi que le suivi des indicateurs d’appétit au risque.

  • Piloter le processus de gestion et de reporting des incidents, en veillant à ce que les incidents soient enregistrés, analysés et suivis de manière appropriée.

  • Suivre les risques opérationnels, non financiers et émergents, notamment les risques liés à la technologie, à la cybersécurité, à la fraude, à l’externalisation et aux processus métiers.

  • Préparer des reportings risques clairs et exploitables à destination de la Direction générale et des instances de gouvernance concernées.

Gouvernance et comités

  • Préparer, coordonner et animer le Comité des risques trimestriel.

  • Accompagner le Chief Compliance & Risk Officer et la Direction générale dans leurs prises de décision liées aux risques.

  • Préparer les supports de gouvernance, tableaux de bord et présentations offrant une vision claire de l’environnement de risques et de contrôle de l’entreprise.

  • Coordonner la définition et la mise à jour des rôles et responsabilités, notamment au travers des matrices RACI.

  • Contribuer aux processus de reporting réglementaire et interne, notamment au rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne, ainsi qu’aux autres reportings réglementaires applicables.

Audits et contrôles réglementaires

  • Coordonner les audits externes, réglementaires et internes portant sur le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels et la gouvernance.

  • Être le point de contact principal des auditeurs et des autorités compétentes sur les sujets de contrôle interne.

  • Gérer les demandes d’audit, la collecte des éléments justificatifs, le suivi des constats et les actions associées.

  • Coordonner la préparation et la mise en œuvre des plans d’actions correctifs et préventifs.

  • Suivre l’avancement des plans de remédiation et présenter les actions à risque élevé ou en retard aux instances de gouvernance appropriées.

  • Coordonner le programme de contrôle périodique et suivre sa mise en œuvre conformément au plan d’audit défini.

Externalisation, continuité d’activité et résilience opérationnelle

  • Garantir la robustesse et la bonne exécution du dispositif PSEE.

  • Contribuer au pilotage des activités externalisées et des prestataires tiers, conformément aux exigences réglementaires applicables.

  • Piloter les activités de continuité d’activité et de résilience opérationnelle de l’entreprise.

  • Maintenir et tester régulièrement les plans de continuité d’activité.

  • Participer aux exercices et aux réunions de gestion de crise lorsque cela est nécessaire.

  • Identifier les opportunités permettant de renforcer la résilience de Lemonway et sa capacité à maintenir ses activités critiques en cas de perturbation.

Politiques, procédures et formation

  • Évaluer les besoins de création ou de mise à jour des politiques, procédures, formulaires et documents de contrôle.

  • Coordonner la rédaction, la revue et la mise en œuvre des procédures de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques.

  • Concevoir ou contribuer à la création de supports de formation et de sensibilisation.

  • Veiller à ce que la documentation soit claire, opérationnelle, à jour et alignée avec le modèle de fonctionnement de l’entreprise.


Expérience

  • Vous avez évolué dans un environnement réglementé, idéalement dans le secteur du paiement ou en fintech.

  • Vous avez déjà encadré une équipe et travaillé sur la structuration ou la transformation d’un dispositif de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne.

Compétences recherchées

  • Bonne compréhension de l’environnement réglementaire français et européen, notamment des attentes de l’ACPR, des orientations de l’EBA, des exigences LCB-FT et de la DSP2.

Anstellungsdetails

Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin


Info

Who we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!


Aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

  • You run and own our self-hosted Apache Kafka backbone and Schema Registry end-to-end, managing ACLs, client quotas, certificates, upgrades, and disaster recovery
  • You operate our Debezium-based change data capture pipelines, overseeing connectors, snapshots, offsets, replica lag, and BigQuery sink loaders 
  • You run our workloads on Kubernetes, including Navarch - our self-built workflow orchestrator executing ~7,500 SQL and Python tasks daily - owning resource management, autoscaling, and debugging
  • You automate and own access management and infrastructure as code across our self-hosted GitLab CI/CD pipelines, replacing manual tickets with code-driven policies
  • You own observability and infra costs - Datadog across Kafka and sink loaders, Slack-native alerting, and maintaining an honest view of K8s, Kafka retention, and log volume expenses
  • You carry your share of triage, one week in three - handling ingestion and access requests, schema alerts, and supporting analysts, while helping automate this layer via AI-assisted review
  • You act as a senior sparring partner alongside two senior data engineers (reporting to the Head of Data & Analytics) - driving design reviews and multi-quarter initiatives, with room to grow into BigQuery architecture over time: access frameworks, partitioning and slot strategy, the pipelines and models on top
  • Optional: You take part in our 24/7 on-call rotation


Profil

Your profile – this is what we expect from you

  • You have several years of experience operating production infrastructure you were personally responsible for, including on-call rotation. You have run systems that broke, can explain what went wrong and how you permanently fixed it, and can detail a specific trade-off you navigated backed by concrete numbers
  • You have deep hands-on expertise in Apache Kafka broker operations, including cluster sizing, partition rebalancing, replication, ISR behavior, and version upgrades
  • You have operated cross-system data replication in production - ideally Debezium on Kafka Connect, or database replication via binlog, GTID, WAL, or agent-based pipelines
  • You demonstrate strong production experience with Kubernetes, master resource management and autoscaling, and possess sharp debugging reflexes for complex failure modes
  • You manage infrastructure and access as code across multiple environments (ideally Terraform and Ansible; Pulumi, Helm or serious configuration management also counts) following a strict least-privilege IAM approach across multiple environments, ideally with GCP experience or transferable AWS/Azure knowledge
  • You use production-grade Python and SQL as practical tools, applying a cost-conscious mindset to query performance, scanning volume, and data pruning
  • You thrive in a low-process, Kanban-driven environment where seniors self-organize, rotate weekly triage duties without micro-management, and prefer automating recurring requests over manually repeating them
  • Optional: You bring skills or interest in object-oriented design, data modeling/dbt, BigQuery architecture, orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster), stream processing (Beam, Flink, Spark), or internal automation (n8n, AI triage bots).
  • You are fluent in English (C1 level) and enjoy working in an international team environment


Benefits

What we offer

  • Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
  • Do you want to move to Germany? No problem – we offer you an attractive relocation package to give you a smooth start. 
  • Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
  • Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
  • Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
  • Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers: Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
  • ‘Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility
  • Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
  • Free choice of operating system: MacOS or Ubuntu Linux, it's up to you
  • Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback. We cover the costs for relevant conferences, training opportunities, and approved team workshops to strengthen personal interactions
  • This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
  • We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!
Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!


Bewerben

Diversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. We are signatories to the Charta der Vielfalt (German Diversity Charter) – because we know that extraordinary things can only be achieved with diversity. Read more here! The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

  • Rohlik Vibe: an international team, flat hierarchies, and an informal culture where mistakes are seen as learning opportunities

 

What You'll Do

  • Identify improvement potential across the fulfillment network — on the floor, in the data, and with operations teams — wherever automation or process redesign can meaningfully improve cost, throughput, quality or safety
