jobs.title: Senior Android Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Kotlin & Android Internals Expertise: You will own the core development and optimization of the adjoe Ads SDK, which runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. We are looking for someone with 8+ years of Android experience (or 3+ years specifically in SDK/library development) who works primarily with Kotlin and has a deep understanding of Android lifecycles, ProGuard/R8, and multithreading to ensure zero tolerance for instability on millions of devices.

  • High-Performance Network Design: You will collaborate with backend teams to design APIs and capture behavioral signals that power 50 billion daily ML predictions. You need a strong track record in API design, maintaining strict backward compatibility for thousands of external integrators, and working with high-performance networking protocols like gRPC, Protobuf, Wire, and OkHTTP.

  • Resource-Constrained Optimization: You will ensure every ad impression feels native and fast while participating in 120 million daily auctions. You must know how to design for minimal footprint, optimizing battery impact and memory usage, as your code executes directly inside someone else’s app and device.

  • Data-Driven Observability: You will monitor, debug, and maintain SDK reliability at scale across millions of global users. You will leverage observability and data tools—including Sentry, Kibana, and AWS (S3, QuickSight, Athena)—to track errors, investigate SDK behavior, and turn raw data into clear engineering decisions.

  • Build Automation & Delivery: You will maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee efficient, reliable SDK delivery. This requires hands-on experience with Gradle and GitLab CI to automate the testing, building, and packaging of our mobile libraries.

  • Plus – AdTech & Low-Level Systems: It is a major plus if you bring experience in ad-tech or programmatic advertising (aligning products with IAB specifications). Additionally, experience with NDK/JNI (C/C++ interop on Android) or parallel iOS development experience is highly valued to help support our cross-platform ecosystem.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Strategic Value Engineer (Presales)
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

 

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German, depending on territory.

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Wir sind ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 500 Mitarbeitenden an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland. Als Ingenieurs- und Beratungsdienstleister sind wir weltweit in Projekten tätig, welche die Energiewende vorantreiben, den Schutz der Umwelt fördern und zur Verbesserung unser aller Lebensqualität beitragen.

Die Position ist in unserer Abteilung Contract & Claim Management angesiedelt (aktuell ca. 4 Mitarbeitende). Sie übernehmen als Contract & Claim Manager (m/w/d) an den Standorten Bremen oder München eine zentrale Rolle in der Bearbeitung und Steuerung von HOAI-basierten Verträgen und Schadensfällen.

Aufgaben, die motivieren

  • Schadenmanagement & Regulierung: Prüfung und Bearbeitung von Ansprüchen bei Ingenieurverträgen nach HOAI, inklusive Verhandlungen und Streitbeilegung bei Leistungsabweichungen oder Kostenüberschreitungen.

  • Vertragsmanagement: Erstellung, Prüfung und Anpassung von Verträgen unter Berücksichtigung der HOAI und des deutschen Vertragsrechts.

  • Honorar & Kostenkontrolle: Beratung zu HOAI-Honoraren, Unterstützung bei Kostenprognosen und -kontrolle während des Projektverlaufs.

  • Streitbeilegung: Zentrale Anlaufstelle für die Klärung von Vertragsstreitigkeiten im HOAI-Kontext.

  • Dokumentation & Reporting: Erstellung von Berichten und Sicherstellung einer lückenlosen Dokumentation für interne und rechtliche Zwecke.

  • Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Projektteams, Rechtsabteilung und externen Partnern zur Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe.

  • Schulung & Wissenstransfer: Weitergabe von Best Practices im Vertrags- und Schadenmanagement an Projektteams

Qualifikationen, die überzeugen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Jura, Baumanagement, Wirtschaftsrecht, Architektur, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrags- und/oder Schadenmanagement,idealerweise mit Bezug zur HOAI

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Vertragsrecht (insbesondere HOAI und BGB)

  • Fähigkeit mehrere Verträge zu verwalten

  • Verbindliches Auftreten, Verhandlungsgeschick, Teamfähigkeit

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit

  • Konfliktlösungsfähigkeit

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch-Kenntnisse (min. C1)


91% unserer Mitarbeitenden stimmen der Aussage zu, dass ILF in Deutschland ein "Great Place to work" ist:

  • Sympathische Unternehmenskultur und gelebte VIeLFalt: Viele lokale aber auch überregionale Live-Events prägen unser Miteinander und der Großteil der Mitarbeitenden ist per "Du". Besonders stolz macht uns die Internationalität unseres Teams mit mehr als 30 unterschiedlichen Nationen.

jobs.title: Move to New Zealand - Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company.
 
We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). 
 
Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.
 
Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).
 
 

The Role:
Propellerhead is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our core engineering team (reporting to the CTO) to research and define future technical strategies for Propellerhead and our clients. The engineering team provides the core tools, techniques, and software libraries to support service development teams.

You will guide proofs of concept to production, mentoring team members on new technologies and practices. You’ll also help our teams and customers navigate the development of effective, secure enterprise software and deployment architectures in the age of AI.

Your team will consist of like-minded software craftspeople and will operate with a degree of autonomy seldom experienced in other organisations.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

If you are ready to work on real problems with real impact, and help lay the groundwork for what comes next - we would like to hear from you.


Role Responsibilities:
  • Define technical solutions through research and team investigation, in line with the vision directed by the CTO.
  • Actively participate in the design and construction of software across the full stack—including code structure, deployment architecture, DevOps, automated testing, and integration of third-party systems. This will primarily involve the use of LLMs, with the expectation you will do virtually no hand-coding.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and fellow Propellerhead team members to ensure a shared understanding of solution design and roadmap delivery in line with agreed budgets.
  • Drive the migration of existing polyglot solutions to standardized Rust and TypeScript, towards more standardized and portable deployment architectures, and pass on technical learning to the broader organisation to embed the technical strategies throughout.

    • Skills and Experience Required:
  • 7+ years experience as a Software Developer or Engineer, including experience working with enterprise-level complexity.
  • High proficiency in at least one enterprise-quality programming language and its ecosystem. For example, C# .NET or Java and Spring.
  • Must have some experience with a lower-level language for application or systems development such as Rust (preferable) or C++. 
  • Experience in TypeScript and React or similar front-end frameworks, and a well-developed understanding of web application development.
  • Hands-on experience deploying to Azure and/or AWS, including building CI/CD pipelines and using infrastructure scripting frameworks (e.g., Terraform).
  • Demonstrable experience in software design for distributed and asynchronous architecture. In particular, you will need to show examples of projects using microservices and messaging where you have been a key contributor to the design and construction.
  • You will already have embraced the use of LLMs over hand-coding and be able to articulate how this has improved the speed to deliver and safety of the systems you build.
  • With the help of LLMs you can produce clear and concise design documents.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills to translate between requirements and technical tasks.

    • About Propellerhead:

    Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    How We Build Software:

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

    Benefits:

    • Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.

    • Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.

    • Opportunity for professional growth and development.

    • Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

    • Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

    • This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).

    • Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

     

    Cover Letter:

    *Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed.

    It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.

    At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients.

    In recruitment, however, AI isn’t used to assess skills, experience or suitability for a role. Every application is reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair, engaged and thoughtfully human process.

    Therefore we kindly ask that you refrain from using it in your application. We're excited to learn about your unique experiences and ideas, so please apply as your authentic self!

     

    More:

    Candidates that progress may be asked to agree to a police background check, credit history check, other assessments and provide evidence of qualifications.

    Learn more about our company here.

Senior Product Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Platform team in an internal-facing role focused on delivery excellence. You'll be the connective tissue across product teams — enabling fast, informed decision-making, keeping engineering delivery on track day-to-day, making sure our platform holds up to country-specific regulatory requirements as we scale globally and defining requirements for the platform back office.

Alongside the day-to-day delivery work, you'll run a set of platform-wide programs: centralizing consent management and interfacing with the GTM team. This role is less about owning a single customer-facing roadmap and more about being the operational and program backbone that keeps cross-functional delivery moving smoothly and compliantly.

What You'll Do

Delivery & Coordination

  • Liaise with Group Product Managers (GPMs) — Act as a key point of coordination across product fault lines, surfacing decisions that need to be made and driving them to quick, well-informed resolution.

  • Lead daily ceremonies — Run stand-ups and other recurring delivery ceremonies with engineering, keeping teams aligned on priorities, blockers, and progress.

  • Troubleshoot with engineering — Partner directly with engineering leads to unblock delivery issues in real time, digging into technical details as needed.

  • Lead triage for cross-cutting bugs and defects — Own the process for identifying, prioritizing, and assigning ownership of issues that span multiple product areas or teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Drive process improvement — Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks or compliance gaps and put in place scalable processes to prevent them.

Platform Delivery (Program)

  • Country-specific requirements — Own the platform-wide program ensuring the platform meets country-specific regulatory and functional requirements (e.g., GDPR and other regional regulations) consistently as we scale globally.

  • Centralize consent management — Lead the program to consolidate consent management (data processing, marketing, cookie consent, etc.) into a single, consistent framework across the platform, replacing fragmented per-product implementations.

  • Build the platform back office for technical support.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including experience in platform or delivery-focused roles.

  • Proven ability to work across multiple teams and stakeholders to drive decisions quickly, especially in ambiguous or contested situations.

  • Strong operational rigor — comfortable running ceremonies, triage processes, and cross-team workflows, alongside running longer-running platform programs and owning a live product.

  • Experience working closely with engineering on troubleshooting and delivery issues; technical fluency is important.

  • Experience owning a partner-facing or multi-market product, with sensitivity to regional variation across a large footprint (70 countries, in this case).

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders (including GPMs) without direct authority.

  • A bias toward action and strong prioritization instincts in a fast-moving, cross-cutting role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a platform or infrastructure product role at a multi-market or global company.

  • Background working with legal/compliance teams on regulatory rollouts, especially consent management programs.

  • Experience setting up or scaling incident management, bug triage, or internal support tooling.

  • Experience with franchise, partner, or multi-tenant portal products specifically.

Why You Should Join

Most internal-facing delivery roles are pure coordination — you keep other people's things moving and own nothing yourself. This one comes with real roadmap and experience decisions for making a platform product portfolio truly global. Sitting across all the GPMs gives you genuine organizational leverage and visibility into the whole product landscape, which builds the kind of cross-functional credibility that prepares you for future leadership roles. You'll also get to build things properly rather than patch them: centralized consent management is greenfield, replacing fragmented per-product implementations that most people inherit and spend years apologizing for.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

Wer wir sind

  

RNA Digital Solutions wurde 2016 als Industrial Tech Startup gegründet. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. 

Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln. 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d) mit Sitz im Raum München. Die Arbeit erfolgt größtenteils mobil, jedoch ist eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Office in München vorgesehen (ca. 1 Mal pro Woche).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die React-basierten Apps kommunizieren über REST mit verschiedenen Django-Backends/-Microservices. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen.

Offre de stage : Electronique flexible pour interfaçage de capteur de gaz portable - 3 à 5 mois
jobs.description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l'Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des sciences et désir d’impact sociétal.

Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz Nox et CO portable pour un monitoring environnemental continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique, valeur par la suite traitée par un microcontrôleur pour permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact.

Le/la candidat(e) devra dans un premier temps mettre en œuvre un prototype de PCB rigide. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

·         Mesure précise de grande valeur de résistance

·         Faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques

·         Transfert du PCB rigide vers un substrat flexible


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes actuellement en troisième année de BUT GEII ou de cursus ingénieur en électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaines associés.

Vous devez :

•      Présenter un fort intérêt pour l’électronique et les systèmes embarqués

•      Présenter une expérience avec les outils de simulation et de conception de circuits électroniques (LTSpice, KiCad, etc.) ainsi qu’en conception de PCB et en programmation de microcontrôleur.

Une approche expérimentale et une connaissance de conception de circuits imprimés sont essentielles.

📩 Postulez Maintenant !

o    Date limite de candidature : 30/09/2026

o    Date de démarrage souhaitée : à partir de septembre 2026 ou durant les mois suivants

o    Durée : 3 à 5 mois

o    Rémunération au taux horaire de 4,50€/heure

o    Stage basé à Gardanne (13) Campus Aix-Marseille Provence

jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

IMT Mines Albi, au travers du Centre Génie Industriel (CGI), développe des recherches à la frontière entre l’intelligence artificielle et le génie industriel, en collaboration avec des partenaires publics et industriels nationaux et internationaux.

Le Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) (https://cgi.imt-mines-albi.fr/) compte environ 70 personnes dont 25 doctorants. Le centre s’intéresse à l’accompagnement de la transition des écosystèmes en permettant de prendre des décisions responsables et durables, dans des environnements instables ou perturbés. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés.

Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont :

  • Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS dans lequel ce poste est rattaché.

  • Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ;

  • Axe TRACE : Territorial Resilience, Agility, and Circular Economy ;

  • Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services.

  • Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont :

  • HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ; Ce poste est rattaché au programme HOPOPOP.

  • AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Contexte

Dans le contexte de l’Industrie 4.0 et au-delà, les acteurs industriels déploient des stratégies de numérisation où les systèmes opérationnels sont connectés à des systèmes cyber de plus en plus intelligents. Dans ce contexte, le jumeau numérique organisationnel désigne le système qui permet une interaction bidirectionnelle entre une organisation physique (personnes et systèmes) et sa réplique virtuelle dans un objectif de pilotage global des flux.

Les revues récentes et les typologies (par ex. Kritzinger et al., 2018 ; Onaji et al., 2022 ; Soori et al., 2023 ; Kober et al., 2024 ; Traoré, 2024 ; Namaki Araghi et al., 2025) sur les jumeaux numériques dans le cadre manufacturier montrent que le JN gère des données d’atelier et interopère avec divers systèmes (MES, ERP, traçabilité, qualité), dispose de modèles de simulation physiques ou basés sur les données axés sur la gestion des flux, et orchestre des services orientés vers le traitement des données ou des modèles de simulation. Le JN a divers objectifs (évaluation des impacts des changements et de la performance, optimisation), et des interactions avec les utilisateurs lorsque nécessaire pour soutenir des décisions à différents horizons (tactique et opérationnel) et potentiellement de différentes natures (planification, maintenance, qualité). La mise en œuvre d’un tel système représente un défi organisationnel et technique majeur qui doit être adapté aux spécificités et évolutions industrielles.

Le projet INFINITY vise à concevoir et tester un système de jumeaux numériques pour soutenir la planification industrielle dans le contexte d’une industrie de traitement de surface. Il est en partenariat avec un industriel phare de ce domaine pour l’industrie aéronautique qui porte le projet sur un financement CORAC. Les projets de jumeau numériques de taille industrielle étant peu fréquents un des enjeux du projet est d’étudier la scalabilité du système proposé et l’impact sur jumeau numérique sur l’organisation. Une partie du projet visant à concevoir de nouveaux procédés de traitement, une partie du sujet porte aussi sur l’évaluation de l’impact de ces nouveaux procédés sur le pilotage du système de production.

Plusieurs thèses sont menées simultanément au sein de ce projet, chacune avec des orientations complémentaires : (i) la collecte de données et la construction des informations nécessaires à la planification ; (ii) le jumeau numérique pour la planification à court et moyen terme ; et (iii) le jumeau numérique pour la planification stratégique d’investissements. L’ingénieur de recherche objet de ce poste aura pour rôle d’intégrer les contributions de ces thèses pour constituer un prototype de jumeau numérique. Il constituera aussi une plateforme d’évaluation de ce jumeau.

Problématique

L’enjeu central du poste est de proposer un système jumeau numérique centré sur un ou des modèles de simulation à capacité finie qui aident à la planification court terme , moyen terme, et stratégique, mais aussi sur des services en appui à cette planification (optimisation de certaines décision, gestion de la polyvalence des opérateurs, rassemblement des commandes pour constituer des tailles de lot, le suivi de paramètres vitaux pour le jumeau [gammes, macro-gammes, mix produit, polyvalence, ...]).

Le jumeau sera conçu en suivant une démarche d’ingénierie système qui formaliser les exigences, anticipe les impacts de la scalabilité et des évolutions de process pour proposer une architecture adaptée à ces évolutions, et évalue la valeur ajoutée du jumeau numérique. Des jeux de données représentatifs de diverses échelles seront constitués en collaboration avec le partenaire industriel porteur du projet INFINITY.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Compétences techniques

  • Ingénierie et architecture de Système informatique

  • Développement informatique

  • Démarche devops

  • Expérience en Simulation à événements discrets et recherche opérationnelle sont un plus recherché.

Compétences transverses

  • Anglais écrit et parlé (niveau minimum B2) et Français (minimum B2)

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler dans une équipe de recherche.

  • Motivation pour contribuer à une application industrielle de la recherche.

Compétences complémentaires (pas indispensable)

  • Connaissances en apprentissage par renforcement et analyse de données massives pour la simulation

jobs.title: Ingénieur∙e de développement — Systèmes interactifs temps réel humain-IA
jobs.description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Contexte du poste :

Le programme national PEPR eNSEMBLE (France 2030) et son programme ciblé MATCHING (https://www.pepr-ensemble.fr/matching-collaboration-avec-des-systemes-intelligents/) portent sur l'étude et la transformation des environnements de collaboration numérique, en visant de nouveaux modèles sociotechniques permettant une collaboration efficace, inclusive et interopérable entre individus et systèmes intelligents. Le poste s'inscrit dans le cadre de deux projets ciblés portés par le programme MATCHING :

•      DÉCAFEIN' : un environnement virtuel collaboratif multi-utilisateurs (réalité virtuelle) dans lequel des participants interagissent avec des agents virtuels socialement interactifs pour résoudre une enquête, avec analyse multimodale du comportement (verbal, non-verbal, physiologique) à des fins thérapeutiques, pédagogiques ou ludiques.

•      CollabJam: un démonstrateur ludique de jeu musical collectif avec une IA générative comme partenaire musical, également conçu comme un outil d’expérimentation scientifique. À travers différents scénarios, il permettra d’étudier différentes formes de collaboration humain–IA, en faisant varier le comportement du partenaire IA (accompagnement, proposition de variations ou perturbations délibérées), ainsi que les formes de communication non-verbale permettant aux participants de partager et négocier leurs intentions esthétiques.

Les deux projets partagent un même défi scientifique et technique : concevoir un système où un agent (virtuel ou musical) perçoit en temps réel des signaux multimodaux produits par un groupe et adapte dynamiquement son propre niveau d'autonomie ou de coopération en fonction de l'activité collective. L'ingénieur(e) recruté(e) contribuera au développement technique des deux démonstrateurs, en priorisant la mutualisation des briques génériques et en respectant les spécificités propres à chacun.

 

1-    MISSIONS

1. Socle commun aux deux projets

•      Concevoir et développer des boucles d'interaction temps réel entre un groupe d'utilisateurs et un agent adaptatif (virtuel ou génératif).

•      Mettre en place l'acquisition, la synchronisation et l'horodatage de flux multimodaux hétérogènes selon le projet (audio, gestuel et physiologique pour DÉCAFEIN' ; flux MIDI pour CollabJam).

•      Implémenter une logique de modélisation d'un « niveau d'agence » ou de coopération de l'agent, piloté par l'historique d'interaction du groupe.

•      Concevoir des mécanismes de restitution de l'état de l'agent aux utilisateurs (feedback, visualisation, retour sensoriel).

•      Contribuer à la production de corpus multimodaux exploitables pour l'évaluation scientifique de la collaboration.

•      Documenter les développements et participer aux échanges avec les équipes de recherche des pôles PC1 et PC3 du programme eNSEMBLE.

2. Spécifique à DÉCAFEIN'

•      Les agents virtuels de DECAFEIN sont incarnés

•      Développer l'environnement de réalité virtuelle multi-utilisateurs sous Unreal Engine 5 (intégration Metahumans pour les agents virtuels).

•      Mettre en œuvre l'architecture matérielle distribuée à 5 postes (4 participants + 1 expert) et la synchronisation réseau entre instances.

•      Intégrer les dispositifs de capture (eye-tracking, fréquence cardiaque, activité électrodermale, audio) et leur horodatage avec les événements de la simulation.

•      Implémenter la logique conditionnant la révélation d'indices par les agents virtuels à la qualité du comportement multimodal détecté chez les participants.

3. Spécifique à CollabJam

•      Le ou les agents virtuels de CollabJam ne sont a priori pas incarnés.

•      Concevoir et développer l’architecture temps réel permettant de capter, analyser et exploiter les interactions musicales d’un groupe de participants (d'abord basé sur des données MIDI avec la possibilité ensuite d'explorer d'autres formes de type audio/gestuelles)

•      Développer les mécanismes d’adaptation du partenaire musical IA afin de faire évoluer son comportement entre imitation, accompagnement, et perturbation.

•      Concevoir et implémenter des scénarios d’interaction permettant d’expérimenter différentes formes de collaboration et de négociation de l’agence entre utilisateurs et IA, à des fins de collecte de données scientifique.

•      Garantir la fluidité de l’expérience musicale en travaillant sur la synchronisation, la réactivité du système et la maîtrise de la latence.

•      Explorer avec les chercheurs du projet des modalités sonores, visuelles ou gestuelles permettant de rendre perceptibles l’état et les intentions de l’IA, et de soutenir la communication non verbale entre participants.


Compétences requises :

✔️ Développement temps réel : Solide expérience en programmation C++ et/ou C# ; conception de systèmes interactifs à contrainte de latence.

✔️ 3D / VR (souhaité) : Unreal Engine 5, idéalement avec Metahumans ; Unity / Godot ; réseau multi-utilisateur en environnement immersif.

✔️ MIDI / musique (souhaité) : Traitement de flux MIDI temps réel (p. ex. JUCE, Max/MSP, RtMidi) ; notions de génération musicale par IA. Le projet CollabJam se limite aux flux MIDI, sans traitement du signal audio.

✔️ Traitement de signaux multimodaux : Acquisition et synchronisation de flux hétérogènes (physiologique, gestuel, audio) ; notions de traitement du signal.

✔️ IA / modèles adaptatifs : Notions d'agents adaptatifs, de modèles génératifs, ou d'apprentissage en ligne appréciées.

✔️ Savoir-être : Autonomie, capacité à travailler avec des équipes de recherche pluridisciplinaires (sciences cognitives, HCI, psychologie), rigueur documentaire.

 

Profil :

🎓 Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master 2 en informatique, IA, informatique graphique, ou traitement du signal audio.

💼 Une expérience antérieure sur au moins un des deux domaines (VR/Unreal Engine ou flux MIDI) est un atout ; l'autre pourra être acquis en poste.

💡 Intérêt pour les problématiques de collaboration humain-IA et d'interaction sociale.

 

Synthèse : mutualisation vs spécificités

Les deux projets partagent un socle commun de compétences en ingénierie de systèmes interactifs temps réel et en modélisation d'agents adaptatifs, mais reposent sur des stacks techniques distincts (moteur de jeu 3D/VR pour DÉCAFEIN', pipeline MIDI temps réel pour CollabJam — le traitement du signal acoustique/audio n'entre pas dans le périmètre de ce poste). Selon le profil du candidat retenu, une répartition du temps de travail entre les deux projets sera définie avec les porteurs scientifiques respectifs.

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

Main mission

Build and execute on Alan's social media organic strategy internationally in order to turn Alan into the undisputed health reference on socials:

  • define Alan's unique voice on social media

  • drive the online conversation about health

  • build our AI-powered production system for scalable content production, and grow engaged communities across platforms

  • execute the social media strategy in France

Detailed missions

1. Build the organic social media strategy

Global role:

  • Define Alan's social voice, creative direction, and platform-specific frameworks (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), including which personas to target on each channel

  • Drive coordination with Brand, Product Marketing, and Growth to ensure social is embedded in every major moment (product launches, campaigns, events)

  • Bridge organic and paid efforts on Meta and YouTube, ensuring both work in concert to maximize reach, consistency, and performance

  • Align with each country team on editorial pillars (key themes and topics reflecting Alan's positioning) and platform priorities (which channels to activate and at what intensity per market)

  • Set the measurement framework: follower composition, UTM tracking, brand awareness surveys, and social listening, with regular performance reviews shared cross-functionally

France execution:

  • Own and execute the France organic social strategy end-to-end, across the full content mix: educational content, product storytelling, employer brand, community engagement, and campaign amplification

  • Ensure France content is consistent with global frameworks while reflecting local market nuances

2. Build and operate an AI-powered content production and distribution engine

  • Design and implement an agentic content workflow using AI tools (LLMs, image generation, video automation) to dramatically increase production velocity without proportional headcount growth

  • Create a scalable system where subject-matter experts across the company (product, medical, growth, country teams) feed raw inputs (data, stories, product updates) that get transformed into publish-ready content at scale

  • Define and operate the distribution logic: publishing cadence, platform-specific formatting, timing, and scheduling across all active channels


3. Build a solid performance and measurement framework

  • Set up and own the measurement framework: follower composition, UTM tracking, brand awareness, social listening

  • Share regular performance reviews cross-functionally

  • Define KPIs connecting social activity to business outcomes (traffic, brand awareness, audience quality)

  • Use data to make autonomous editorial decisions and iterate on content strategy

Key outcomes by 1 year

  1. A clear, living organic social media strategy is in place and understood across Alan — platforms are prioritized, editorial pillars are defined, and Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, and country teams are aligned on what Alan stands for on social and how to contribute to it

  2. An AI-powered content production system is operational : agentic workflows handle scheduling, drafting, and basic repurposing, freeing up human time for creative strategy and high-value content

  3. Platform activation and posting cadence have been defined and implemented based on audience data and strategic priorities

  4. A measurement framework is live : we know who follows us, whether content drives traffic, and whether brand awareness among target audiences is moving

  5. Social has demonstrably amplified at least 2 major brand campaigns: the person has owned the organic social amplification strategy end-to-end for at least two significant brand moments, with measurable contribution to reach and engagement vs. previous benchmarks

 

⭐️ Requirements for the role

Hard skills

Social strategy & editorial thinking

  • Able to build a platform-specific organic social media strategy from scratch: define objectives, prioritize platforms, set an editorial calendar, and adapt the approach based on data

  • Strong editorial judgment: knows what Alan should say, how, and where, and can make fast, autonomous decisions decisively

Content production

  • Can produce social-first content autonomously across formats (short video, carousel, static, copy-led posts), both hands-on and through AI-assisted workflows

  • Experienced with AI tools for content creation and able to design agentic pipelines

  • Has an eye for what works natively on each platform, not someone who repurposes the same content everywhere

Data & analytics

  • Able to read social analytics and turn them into actionable editorial decisions

  • Experienced building simple and rigorous reporting frameworks

 

Soft skills / Behavioural traits

  • Ownership mindset : takes full responsibility for the social presence

  • Systems thinker : thinks in workflows and leverage points, not just individual posts

  • Scrappy and resourceful : comfortable with frugality — finds creative solutions with limited budget, doesn't need a big production team to produce great content

  • Curious and fast-learning : obsessed with what's new on social, on AI tools, on platform algorithm changes — and translates that curiosity into experiments

  • Collaborative: builds strong working relationships across teams, communicates clearly, and makes it easy for others to contribute to social

  • Strategic and business-aware: understands that social is a business tool, so is able to balance reach and engagement with brand coherence, audience quality, and broader company objectives

  • Comfortable with ambiguity : the social strategy is not fully defined yet. This person needs to be energized by building on a blank page, not paralyzed by it

Languages

  • French : native level, perfect written syntax — the majority of content will be in French

  • English : fluent (working language at Alan, used daily)

  • Spanish or Dutch : a plus given Alan's presence in Spain and Belgium


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

This role gives you direct influence over how a deep tech company engages with some of the most important policy debates in Europe today. Deine Mission

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für unseren Standort Berlin einen erfahrenen Senior Elektroingenieur (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Analogelektronik und Messtechnik, der mit seinem Know-how unsere Mess- und Inspektionstechnologie technisch weiter voranbringt.

EMPIT ist ein wachsendes Deep-Tech-Unternehmen, das Mess- und Inspektionssysteme für den internationalen Einsatz an kritischer Infrastruktur entwickelt. Mit unseren Technologien machen wir sichtbar, was sonst verborgen bleibt, und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit kritischer Infrastruktur.

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. Dabei entstehen Lösungen, die kompakt, zuverlässig und für den internationalen Einsatz ausgelegt sind. 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Stromversorgungen weiterentwickeln: Leistungsfähigkeit, Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Stromquellen verbessern und auf die Anforderungen unserer Messsysteme abstimmen.
  • Platinen und elektronische Baugruppen entwickeln: Schaltungen aufbauen, Prototypen in Betrieb nehmen, Messergebnisse bewerten und bestehende Hardware gezielt optimieren.
  • Elektronik kompakter machen: Bestehende Baugruppen hinsichtlich Größe, Gewicht und Aufbau optimieren, damit unsere Systeme sicher und effizient transportiert werden können – auch per Flugzeug.
  • Signalgeneratoren neu denken: Bestehende Komponenten analysieren, technische Grenzen hinterfragen und neue Lösungen für unsere Signalgeneratoren und Messsysteme entwickeln.
  • Technische Herausforderungen lösen: Fehler systematisch analysieren, Ursachen identifizieren und eigenständig praxistaugliche Lösungen bis zur Umsetzung bringen.
  • Technologie mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Konzepte entwickeln und technische Entscheidungen für die nächste Generation unserer Mess- und Inspektionssysteme vorantreiben.

Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen mit langfristiger, familiengeprägter Unternehmenskultur suchen wir einen erfahrenen Manager Source to Pay Solutions (m/w/d) am Standort Mannheim.

Das Unternehmen befindet sich in einer umfassenden globalen S/4HANA-Transformation. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Einkauf, Business und IT.

Hier geht es nicht nur darum, die bestehende SAP-Landschaft stabil zu betreiben.

Sie gestalten mit, wie Source-to-Pay-Prozesse in Zukunft funktionieren.

Aufgaben

Was macht diese Position besonders?

Sie verbinden Business-Prozesse, SAP und internationale Transformation.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:

  • Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung und den stabilen Betrieb der SAP S2P-/MM-Lösungen im Einkauf und in der Bestandsführung
  • Konzeption, Umsetzung und Steuerung von SAP-MM-Projekten und internationalen Rollouts

Sie verwalten nicht einfach bestehende SAP-Prozesse, Sie helfen dabei, die zukünftige Lösung zu gestalten.

Qualifikation

Lead/Principal Management & Technology Consultant  - Manufacturing/Production
Lead/Principal Digital Transformation & Process Optimisation Consultant - Manufacturing/Production

Product Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Für Design ist das ein seltener Ausgangspunkt: Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Für diese Berufe hat noch nie jemand ernsthaft gestaltet. Du wärst die erste Design-Person in unserem neuen Produktteam und baust Design-System und Designprozess mit auf.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Wir arbeiten als ein Team von Product Engineers, manche technischer, manche gestalterischer. Du wärst die gestalterischste Person, arbeitest aber im selben Repository und Rhythmus wie alle anderen. Was du gestaltest, ist meist wenige Wochen später live.
  • Du verantwortest den Designprozess von Anfang bis Ende: Du führst Interviews mit Verwaltern und Eigentümern, verdichtest die Erkenntnisse zu Konzepten und gestaltest daraus Interfaces für Kundenportal und Verwaltercockpit. Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg.
  • Deine Designs bleiben nicht in Figma: Mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) bringst du sie selbst ins Frontend und setzt Teil-Features, teils auch ganze Features, gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Produkt landet, und legst dafür selbst Hand an.
  • Ein besonderes Feld ist Design für KI-Agenten: Du gestaltest Interaktionsmuster für Workflows, in denen Agenten Aufgaben übernehmen. Wo braucht der Nutzer Kontrolle, wo Transparenz? Muster, für die es noch kaum Vorbilder gibt.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign, gern mit B2B-Software oder komplexen Workflows.
  • Ein Portfolio mit 2 bis 3 Case Studies, die deinen Weg von der Nutzerfrage bis zum ausgelieferten Interface zeigen: Deine Denkweise interessiert uns mehr als die Menge an Screens.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, von Wireframes über klickbare Prototypen bis zur Komponentenbibliothek.
  • Erfahrung mit qualitativem Research: Interviews führen, Erkenntnisse verdichten, Annahmen mit Usability-Tests prüfen.
  • Gespür für Interaction Design und Informationsarchitektur in datenreichen Anwendungen.
  • Gute bis sehr gute Praxis mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, v0): Du bringst Teil-Features oder ganze Features selbst in den Code.
  • Solide Grundlagen in HTML und CSS, JavaScript ist ein Plus.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du gestaltest, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
  • Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, Richtung UX Engineering oder Produktverantwortung, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich.
  • Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
  • Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
  • Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.

jobs.title: Back End Engineer - Partner Flow
jobs.description:
Back End Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Back End Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

  • Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

  • Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

  • Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

  • Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

  • Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

  • Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

  • Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

  • Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

  • Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

  • Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact.

  • A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own.

  • AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

Compensation: £60K – £85K

jobs.title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June  - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.

  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.

  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

  • Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.

  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen.

  • Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort



Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

As the Events & Brand experience team, we design and execute Back Market’s most creative campaigns and physical activations across the globe. From large-scale events like BackForum to limited-budget campaigns, we bring Back Market’s voice to life both offline and online.

To support this mission, we’re looking for an Events Operations Apprentice to join our fast-paced team.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

🎯 1. Event Production & Operations

  • Assist in organizing external events from A to Z: planning, briefing, logistics, budget tracking, and execution.

  • Be the go-to support for “run” tasks, sourcing, and project troubleshooting.

  • Contribute to creating post-event reports, wrap-ups, and learnings.

🎁 2. Low-Budget Productions

  • Help produce brand content and goodies in-house with limited resources (without agency support).

  • Handle shipping logistics, coordination, and production tasks (examples: influencers' events at the Future Club, small productions of PR dinners in Paris…)

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • A team player, curious and adaptable, with a strong sense of initiative.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.

  • Passionate about events, branding, and creative culture.

  • Comfortable working in both French & English (written and spoken).

  • Ready to juggle multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced, international environment.

  • Bonus point if you already had an international experience, and/or if you have already completed an internship/work-study program in event management, or as a production assistant.

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP: ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24 months to be discussed).

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  1. Technical Interview with the manager (45 mins)

  2. Cultural fit interview With a member of the team (30 min)

  3. Case study (Home assignement/Case preparation)

  4. Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30min)

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Electronics Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Sécheron Hasler Group continues the Swiss tradition of over 140 years in the field of railway technology. We are a leading global supplier of electrical and electronic safety components and solutions and traction power systems for the railway industry and also provide solutions for renewable energy, DC grid, and other industrial systems. The name Sécheron Hasler Group is worldwide synonymous with Swiss Quality and represents a leading reference for state-of-the-art products supplied to the market.

With more than 1400 employees worldwide, we are wherever our customers are around the globe. We supply products approved in our customers’ countries or markets and deliver top-notch supply chain and customer services locally. We are looking for a skilled Industrial Coordination Manager to join our team. The role is based in France, with a French employment contract and local employment conditions.

Main Tasks

  • Participate in the design phase to understand and integrate constraints.
  • Define and validate manufacturing processes (assembly, testing, quality control).
  • Maintain manufacturing documentation UpToDate (BOMs, routings, procedures).
  • Coordinate interactions between R&D, production, quality and procurement teams.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues during production.
  • Participate in monitoring EMS manufacturing performance in terms of production capacity, quality, cost and delivery.
  • Define and coordinate implementation of assembly and testing phases for the final product in our Prague production unit.
  • Manage and monitor orders between Prague and the EMS manufacturing plant based on annual sales forecasts.
  • Lead prototyping, pre-series and ramp-up phases of the new product.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a design office or electronic product manufacturing environment.
  • Degree in Electronics Engineering.
  • Previous experience as an Industrialization / Methods Engineer and/or Industrial Transfer Manager.
  • Experience managing technical projects, including planning, coordination, and reporting.
  • Ability to produce clear, structured, and comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of electronics, including electronic schematics, components, and industry standards (CE, RoHS, IPC, etc.).
  • Good understanding of industrial processes, including PCB assembly, testing, quality control, and traceability.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, including BOMs, mechanical drawings, and manufacturing files.
  • Experience working with CAD tools such as Altium, Eagle, SolidWorks, or similar.
  • Basic knowledge of automation and testing, including test benches, microcontroller programming, and validation scripts.
  • Fluent in both French and English.

Benefits

We have flat hierarchies and encourage direct communication between departments and levels of management. This enables us to make decisions quickly.

We give our employees total responsibility for their job tasks. All employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute to the company’s operational excellence and have ample opportunities to achieve their personal and career growth objectives.

Your success in our global company will be supported by an ambitious international team and excellent working conditions.
